chosen_titles.rationale: Legislative Law (LEG) houses Article 1-A, the Regulation of Lobbying Act / Lobbying Act (§1-a et seq.) - the canonical section-leaf-bearing codification of NY's lobbying-disclosure regime.
RLA - Regulation of Lobbying Act 1040/81 is Justia's parallel codification path for the same lobbying-disclosure act; fetched to confirm whether it exposes section bodies or only a single-page stub.

notes: NY 2010 available on Justia. NY codifies the lobbying-disclosure regime (Legislative Law Article 1-A, the Lobbying Act / RLA, Ch. 1040/81) under multiple parallel paths: leg/ (Legislative Law, canonical), rla/ (Regulation of Lobbying Act), and a cross-reference under exc/ (Executive). Selecting leg/ as primary plus rla/ to verify which path bears actual Article 1-A section leaves. exc/ excluded as it is an Executive-Law cross-reference stub per the 5/15 pilot finding.
